structured.feedback: It overpromises despite the reviews: it claims talking and breathing "feel more comfortable" and that the frame fits the face well, though reviewers say they couldn't talk while wearing it and it doesn't stay in place. It also contradicts itself by saying "Every pack includes five" right before listing 5/10/15/20-piece options, and it repeats "breathe/breathing" heavily.
